record: Golden capture for the polaris-dossier S1 daemon-entry test (syzygy-qkea.2): the built apps/syzygy entry observed from outside, before the dossier dispatch guard and after it. The literals in packages/cap1-system/src/daemon-entry-unchanged.system.test.ts are copied from `before`. Not authority.
method: `captureScript` below, run with node against each built checkout: `before` is a clean worktree at the base commit after `npm ci && npm run build`; `after` is the S1 worktree after `npm run build`. Environment variables named SYZYGY_* are removed. Temporary directories are masked as <TMP>, the working directory as <BASE> or <CWD>, the state directory as <STATE> and the bound port as <PORT>.

                      reviews still required, from its run directory
